stories.headline: GPT-6 Astra just cracked a 20-year-old Enigma cipher
stories.blurb: OpenAI's new model solved an encrypted message that had stumped cryptographers since 2005. The breakthrough shows language models can now tackle historical codebreaking problems that required deep contextual knowledge and pattern recognition across decades-old documents.
stories.why_it_matters: AI can now solve real cryptographic puzzles humans couldn't crack for two decades.
stories.original_headline: OpenAI GPT–6 Astra breaks Enigma message that has resisted solution since 2005

stories.headline: Meta just patched a zero-day that let attackers hijack its Muse AI agent
stories.blurb: Security researcher Patrick Wardle found an undocumented setting in Meta's Muse macOS app that let local attackers redirect the AI agent's transcription processing away from Meta's servers. Meta has shipped a patch, but the exploit was active before discovery.
stories.why_it_matters: AI agents with system access create new attack surfaces that traditional security models weren't built for.
stories.original_headline: Meta patches Muse exploit that let attackers control the AI agent

stories.headline: OpenAI's AI solved over 100 unsolved math problems
stories.blurb: OpenAI announced its AI systems have resolved more than 100 previously unsolved mathematical problems. The company is forming an advisory group to oversee this work, though the group won't have authority to slow or redirect the research itself.
stories.why_it_matters: AI is now solving problems mathematicians couldn't crack, not just answering known questions faster.
stories.original_headline: OpenAI forms math advisory group as its AI resolves more than 100 open problems

stories.headline: NVIDIA just shipped GPU-accelerated tools for robots that perceive and act
stories.blurb: Isaac ROS 5.0 gives developers GPU-accelerated packages built on the open ROS framework to build robots that can perceive, reason, and act in real environments. The release targets developers building sophisticated robotics applications that need to handle dynamic environments.
stories.why_it_matters: Open-source robotics just got the GPU speed boost needed for real-time physical AI.
stories.original_headline: NVIDIA Isaac ROS 5.0 Advances Agentic, Open Source Robotics Development
